baseline.method: Independent qualified original,complete41rings and1395000 observed voxels

reference_role: Qualified published-method estimate; no independent galaxy truth
nrmse_definition: For rotation and dispersion separately: sqrt(mean((estimate-reference)^2))/(max(reference)-min(reference)); no cross-quantity range or scaling
angle_definition: RMS of degree differences wrapped to[-180,180), equivalence under whole360-degree turns
observation_consistency: Full-cube RMS in Jy/beam against all1395000 native observed voxels; evaluated for every otherwise passing profile submission, no output mask or fitted gain
tolerance_provenance: Source-only freeze before cleaned extraction:1.5times worst independent source-seed field discrepancy;1.1times worst original full-cube RMS. Same-seed self-comparison is not the tolerance basis
